workLog.phase: Measure the gate failure and trace every orphan
actions: Ran scan.py on default targets against clean main and got VERDICT: CRITICAL_FAIL with 32 findings across 12 spec files
Grouped findings by referenced entity: 24 point at one retired script, and the rest split across three more
Ran git log --diff-filter=D on each missing path to find the commit that removed it, rather than guessing whether a replacement exists
workLog.outcome: 32 findings on 30 distinct lines across 12 files, every one traced to a deliberate deletion: #2187 retired the count validator, #3432 removed the bundle registry as dead code, #1141 migrated the traceability script to Python, #610 renamed the session-end validator, and two skill names were folded into `session`

workLog.phase: Check whether the repo had already decided this question
actions: Found .agents/critique/001-fix-validate-sessionend-references-critique.md, which rejected an earlier plan for rewriting historical records
Confirmed the current correction already lives in .claude/commands/build.md, which states the old marketplace count validator has been retired and points contributors at the ignore directives
Read .agents/specs/STATUS.md, which documents the repo's supersession convention: mark the status, cite the successor, keep the file in place
workLog.outcome: Rewriting the original prose would introduce anachronism the repo has already ruled against, but the repo does have a convention for marking a spec superseded, which is annotation rather than rewriting

workLog.phase: Choose the narrower of the two escape hatches
actions: Read the directive table in the skill: file scope skips the whole file, line scope skips one line
Counted base-tree precedent at d544eaa60a with git grep: 25 line-scope and 22 file-scope directives already present
Chose line scope because the skill's own anti-pattern list warns that file scope on a spec masks real orphans, and these specs stay in the scan
workLog.outcome: 30 directives across 12 files, verified by diff to be pure suffix appends with no prose changed. Landed as 89bfb7a398, 34051e14e8, and e0d5390dd7

workLog.phase: Adversarial review caught that the directives alone were dishonest
actions: Ran a review on a different model with the explicit question: is any silenced line an active instruction rather than historical narrative

The reviewer flagged that the specs carry status draft, todo, and in-progress, and that many flagged lines are imperative: Create bundle_registry.py, MUST import from, shall replace the hard-coded PLUGIN_COUNTERS dict, THE SYSTEM SHALL invoke

Verified the reviewer rather than trusting it: COUNT_PATTERN and LABEL_MAP are absent from patterns.py, tests/test_command_bundles.py and BUNDLE_REGISTRY no longer exist, and PLUGIN_COUNTERS matches nothing in the tree, so all three instructions are unimplementable as written
Also verified two false claims in the first draft of this log: the precedent counts were 25 and 22, not 39 and 29, and the 32 findings sit on 30 lines, not 32
workLog.outcome: Added a dated retirement note after the H1 of the nine affected specs naming the removed dependency, the PR, and the commit, and stating the instructions below are no longer actionable. The directives now sit under a banner that tells the reader the truth instead of hiding a live contract pointing at a deleted file
